model.title: To require the Secretary of Agriculture to convey the Pleasant Valley Ranger District Administrative Site to Gila County, Arizona.
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee, Natural Resources Committee · Rep. Elijah Crane (R-AZ)

summary.text: The bill would require the federal government to transfer approximately 232.9 acres of National Forest land in Arizona to Gila County, provided the county commits to using the property to serve and support veterans. If the county stops using the land for that purpose, ownership would revert back to the federal government, and the county would bear all costs associated with the transfer, including surveys and environmental assessments.
